زَلَخَانٌ and زَلْخَانٌ (assumed tropical:) The advancing, or preceding, accord. to the K, in going, or gait, but accord. to the parent-lexicons, in haste, or quickly; as also زلجان [i. e. زَلَجَانٌ, which is an inf. n.; and in like manner زَلَخَانٌ and زَلْخَانٌ, accord. to the TK, are inf. ns., of which the verb is زَلَخَ, aor.
زَلُخَ ; though it is more probably
زَلَخَ ]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
